definitions.heldCalls: Distinct held prospect calls or meetings involving Charles; scheduled, canceled, no-show, internal, recruiting and asynchronous exchanges are excluded.
definitions.qualifiedCompanies: Distinct Charles-qualified companies among the selected period's confirmed held prospect calls. Use the latest explicit owner decision or direct documented Charles commercial approval; a stage label alone cannot qualify a company.
definitions.opportunityAcceptances: Distinct commercial opportunities explicitly accepted by Charles with an active next step, counted by the original acceptance date. New CRM records and stage labels alone do not establish acceptance.
definitions.clientWins: Distinct companies becoming a client for the first time under Charles's commercial ownership, counted by the verified first win date. Renewals, expansions and reopened records are excluded.
